subject: Status: D4RL repro matches, tuning caveat for the memo
body:
Status.

Repro: the D4RL locomotion suite matches the paper within seed noise — on hopper-medium-expert-v0 we hit the reported score band on 4 of 5 seeds, and the Fisher divergence penalty clearly does the work: ablating it collapses the critic exactly as described. Mujoco licensing cleared with only a few days' delay.

Internal port (Freya): first runs on our logged navigation dataset are promising but expose a gap — our behavior data is much narrower than D4RL's medium-expert mixtures, and with narrow data the regularizer strength needs retuning per dataset; default hyperparameters underfit noticeably. That tuning burden is the honest caveat for the memo: Fisher-BRC works, but it isn't config-free on real logs.

Linnea is building the evaluation grid so the July round quantifies tuning sensitivity properly. On track for the Jun 12 memo.

Gustavo
